plannedBreakingChanges36.whatChanges: Removal of FMS Guardrails Orchestrator. NeMo Guardrails becomes the default guardrail service.
plannedBreakingChanges36.migrationAction: Migrate workloads off FMS Guardrails Orchestrator to NeMo Guardrails before upgrading to 3.6.

plannedBreakingChanges36.whatChanges: Deprecate LMEvalJob in favor of a native LM-Eval-Harness EvalHub adapter.
plannedBreakingChanges36.migrationAction: Stop authoring new LMEvalJob custom resources. Port existing evaluation jobs to the EvalHub SDK/CLI before upgrading to 3.6.

plannedBreakingChanges36.whatChanges: Praxis-based AI Gateway becomes the data plane for the MaaS control plane, replacing Envoy + IPP + shim stacks.
plannedBreakingChanges36.migrationAction: Keep gateway config under version control; test against Praxis in EA before cutover. HttpRoute/provider-translation configuration will change.

plannedBreakingChanges36.whatChanges: Notebooks 2.0 Tech Preview: new WorkspaceKind-based workbench model.
plannedBreakingChanges36.migrationAction: Do not build new automation against Notebooks 1.x per-workbench custom-resource assumptions. Re-validate workbench provisioning scripts against WorkspaceKinds before committing to 2.0.

plannedBreakingChanges36.whatChanges: Renaming TrustyAI Operator to AI Safety Operator, plus refactoring the TrustyAI Service from Java to Python.
plannedBreakingChanges36.migrationAction: Update automation, Argo CD apps, and operator subscriptions that reference the TrustyAI Operator name/GVK before Q4 2026. Re-validate TrustyAI-service API consumers against the refactored runtime.

upgradePathNotes: 3.3.2 (not 3.3.0/3.3.1) is the first 3.x release supporting migration from 2.x, and only from 2.25.4 or later.
At 3.5 GA: dedicated migration guide 'Assess and plan for migration from 2.25.9+ to 3.5' using rhai-cli, covering side-by-side and in-place approaches.
Anyone who configured llm-d flow control during the 3.4 TP window must update the API group, metrics prefix, and saturation-detector configuration path before/during the 3.5 upgrade.
Unconverted ModelMesh/KServe Serverless models return HTTP 503 immediately after upgrade with no grace period.
Custom workbench images built against oauth-proxy must be rebuilt for kube-rbac-proxy or they fail with redirect loops.
